description: The true path of the miniature: a thing spoiled, three who could have done it, and what each had said they wanted; the deed brought about what only one of them wanted, and it is not the one who took the cup by it.

moves.see: keep the marrow off the bench
moves.why: What the slashing did was to keep it off the bench.
Pask wanted to beat it on the bench, and that he cannot do now.
The cup came to him the one way he said he would not have it.
Martha wanted Abel to win once more.
Abel said that very morning that he wanted it kept off the bench.
He would sooner have no marrow than a second-best one.
